events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Charlie McAvoy scored 39 seconds into overtime and Jeremy Swayman stopped 14 shots on Tuesday night to earn the Boston Bruins their 13th straight victory at home, 2-1 over the Los Angeles Kings.
headlines.shortLinkText: US Olympian McAvoy scores in OT as Bruins beat Kings 2-1 for 13th straight victory at home

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Jack Quinn capped his three-goal outing with an empty-netter, and the Buffalo Sabres won their eighth straight by beating the San Jose Sharks 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Quinn scores 3 and Buffalo Sabres beat San Jose Sharks 6-3 for 8th straight win

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Oliver Kapanen scored his 20th of the season as the Montreal Canadiens held on for a 3-1 win and handed the Toronto Maple Leafs their eighth consecutive loss Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oliver Kapanen scores as Canadiens hand Maple Leafs 8th straight loss

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Conor Garland scored two goals for the second consecutive game and the Columbus Blue Jackets defeated the Tampa Bay Lightning 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conor Garland scores 2 to send Blue Jackets past Lightning, 5-2

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Carter Verhaeghe scored two goals in the final 90 seconds to rally the Florida Panthers to a 4-3 victory over the Detroit Red Wings on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carter Verhaeghe scores 2 late goals, rallying Panthers to 4-3 win over Red Wings

events.name: Calgary Flames at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Rangers forward Alexis Lafreniere got his second career hat trick and Jonathan Quick stopped 21 shots as the New York Rangers defeated the Calgary Flames 4-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexis Lafreniere's hat trick leads Rangers over Flames 4-0

headlines.description: — Jackson Blake converted on the decisive shootout goal and the Carolina Hurricanes recovered after relinquishing a two-goal lead late in regulation to beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blake's shootout goal rescues Hurricanes in 5-4 win over Penguins

events.name: New York Islanders at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Mathew Barzal scored in overtime to cap the New York Islanders' rally from a three-goal deficit for a 4-3 win over the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barzal scores OT winner to cap rally, and Islanders edge Blues 4-3

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Jamie Benn scored the go-ahead goal on a power play in the second period and Jake Oettinger stopped 25 of 26 shots as the Dallas Stars beat the Vegas Golden Knights 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benn's power-play goal, Oettinger's 25 saves lead Stars past Golden Knights 2-1

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored his 37th goal of the season, Matt Boldy notched his 36th, and Filip Gustavsson earned his fourth shutout of the season as the Minnesota Wild defeated the Utah Mammoth 5-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov, Boldy score as Wild blank Mammoth 5-0

headlines.description: — Ryan Poehling had a goal and an assist to lead the Anaheim Ducks to a 4-1 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks’ second-period outburst helps to sink Jets 4-1

headlines.description: — Ryan Nugent-Hopkins scored two goals, Connor McDavid had a goal and an assist, and the Edmonton Oilers defeated the Colorado Avalanche 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid’s late power-play winner lifts the Oilers past the Avalanche 4-3

headlines.description: — Ryan Ufko scored his first NHL goal with 5:35 to play in the second period to put the Nashville Predators ahead to stay in a 4-2 win over the Seattle Kraken on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Ufko scores his first NHL goal as the Predators beat the Kraken 4-2
